environment.protocol: Each stationary scenario runs baseline then candidate. Moving scenarios run baseline/candidate then candidate/baseline (ABBA), in fresh browser processes on the same runner. CPU profiles are collected separately after timing, only in the first repetition.

aggregation: Arithmetic mean of the independent per-run metrics; minima/maxima describe repeated runs, not confidence bounds. Stationary cases have one pair. Moving cases have two pairs in ABBA order.
limitations: Main-thread task CPU uses CDP threadTicks and includes the metric interval/probe transfer.
rAF is scheduling cadence; map resolves are submissions. Neither is final display presentation.
SwiftShader is a software GPU; these measurements are not hardware-GPU FPS.
Held-key moving workloads are identical inputs but faster simulation can travel farther; public HUD poses are retained for every run.

Wall-clock timing and moving endpoint differences mean stationary images are the appropriate direct before/after visual comparison. Pixel-window changes are intentional in minified Perspective Pixel façades.

stationary_images.scope: 1200×780 browser PNGs. Map rectangle x0,y60,width1200,height663 excludes toolbar/footer but includes identical stationary HUD overlays. Additional x345,y60,width850,height520 crop excludes upper-left settings HUD and bottom touch controls. Pixel differences are reported, not treated as failures because minified Perspective Pixel windows intentionally change.

cpu_profile_observations.scope: Separate post-measurement profiles, one per selected scenario/variant. Sampled elapsed weights are diagnostic and not the timed CDP thread-CPU measurement. The deployed native WASM has no name/custom symbol section, so wasm-function indices are revision-local and cannot be mapped to C# method names or compared as stable method identities.
cpu_profile_observations.grouping: Self samples: (idle), (program), wasm-function names/.wasm URL, selected named WebGL binding functions, (garbage collector), other. Inclusive categories are not added.
